rubric.description: Uses an if/else-if/else chain that checks the conditions in order from highest to lowest
Correctly tests score >= 90 for "A" and score >= 80 for "B"
Returns "F" as the default when none of the above conditions are true
Combines the age check with isCitizen using the logical AND operator (&&)
Extracts the first character of word correctly (e.g. charAt(0))
Converts the extracted character to a consistent case for comparison (e.g. Character.toLowerCase)
Correctly checks the character against all five vowels using a compound boolean expression with ||
